title: Products and projects modelled for 3D printing
subtitle: 3D printed solutions
intro: Here are some of the projects we have printed to order: practical accessories for the home, sport and hobbies, organisers, toys and gifts. Every part starts from a ready model or an idea and is made from carefully chosen filament – you can have it in the colour and size you want, and the price depends on the model's weight.

practical.heading: Practical items and accessories
practical.caption: Bookmarks, headphone stands, coin holders, sports equipment holders and drone guards – functional parts designed and printed with everyday use in mind.

cta.title: Like one of the projects?
cta.description: We'll print it in the colour and size you choose – or make something from your own idea.

toys.heading: Toys for hand painting
toys.subheading: Explore our unique toys, ready for a creative touch
toys.caption: Figures printed and ready to paint – great as a gift, for children and for creative time at home.
